description: Spec 036, Befund 2.1 (V-1): an achromatic brand – color.link.rest and visited resolve to the colour of color.text.default – whose link in running text has no underline at rest (the Ero-Token of that cell resolves to 0px). The link then differs from the text by nothing: rejected with a suggestion to bind the underline, never by a silent turn to a colourful link.
